summary.en-US: Fill passwords, one-time codes and passkeys from your self-hosted PassAuth vault. End-to-end encrypted: your server never sees your passwords.

version.approval_notes:
PassAuth is an open-source password manager (https://github.com/Fahed-Alhammadi/PassAuth). The add-on talks only to the PassAuth server the user enters at sign-in (self-hosted; nothing goes to the developer). Vault items are encrypted in the browser (XChaCha20-Poly1305, Argon2id), so the server stores ciphertext only; the account email and encrypted vault are the declared data (authenticationInfo, personallyIdentifyingInfo).

Build from the attached source: see README.md and BUILD_INFO.txt at its top folder (Rust core compiled to WebAssembly with wasm-bindgen, TypeScript bundled with Vite, then `pnpm package:firefox`). The output zip is reproducible.

Notes for review: innerHTML is only set to fixed markup bundled with the add-on (SVG icons, its own CSS); page and vault text is always set with textContent. The offscreen-document code is the Chrome path and never runs in Firefox (Firefox's background page writes the clipboard itself). The page-world script (webauthn.js, world MAIN) forwards passkey requests to the add-on.

To test: run a server with Docker as described in docs/SELF_HOSTING.md of the repository (image ghcr.io/fahed-alhammadi/passauth), create an account in its web vault, then sign in to the add-on with the server's address. A test account on our demo server is available on request.
